newsitem.title: USA: Clinton saddened by haj blaze, sends condolences.
newsitem.headline: Clinton saddened by haj blaze, sends condolences.

text.p: President Bill Clinton said on Tuesday he was deeply saddened by the tragedy in Saudi Arabia in which more than 200 Moslem pilgrims died as fire swept through their encampment.
The blaze, starting from a cooking gas cylinder and fanned by high winds as it raced through a vast sea of tents, killed at least 217 and injured more than 1,000 near the holy city of Mecca.

Most of the victims were reported to be from India, Pakistan and Bangladesh. They were among some two million Moslems from 100 countries gathering for the annual haj pilgrimage, which reaches its climax on Wednesday.
"I was deeply saddened to learm today of the tragic loss of life in Saudi Arabia among the pilgrims performing the haj," Clinton said in a written statement.
"I have sent condolences to King Fahd on behalf of the American people, and extend my deepest sympathy to the families of those who were killed or injured in the fire," he said.
